cards.card_text: Miserable comforters Faithful counselors Wise old teachers
cards.verse_text: “I have heard many things like these; miserable comforters are you all.
cards.snippet: “I have heard many things like these; miserable comforters are you all.

cards.card_text: He looked for comforters, but he found ___.
cards.verse_text: I looked for sympathy, but there was none, for comforters, but I found no one.
cards.snippet: I looked for sympathy, but there was none, for comforters, but I found no one.

cards.card_text: The oppressed have no comforter, and the Teacher saw that the ___ lay in the hands of their oppressors.
cards.verse_text: I saw the tears of the oppressed, and they had no comforter; the power lay in the hands of their oppressors, and there was no comforter.
